test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following 'ashrams' was NOT established by Mahatma Gandhi?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Paunar.__**

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__****

__
 
• **Param Dham Ashram** is established by **Acharya Vinoba Bhave** in the year 1934 on the bank of river Dham in Paunar village five miles way from Wardha.
 
• Vinoba Bhave came to **Wardha** in 1921 to start a Satyagraha Ashram on the lines of one at Ahmedabad.
 
• Vinoba Bhave was the **founder of the Bhoodan Yajna (“Land-Gift Movement”)**.
 
• Gandhi's teachings led Bhave to a life of austerity dedicated to improving Indian village life.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• It was 1936 when **Mahatma Gandhi** left Sabarmati ashram and set up his ashram in Sevagram, a small village in Wardha town in Maharashtra.
 
• Mahatma Gandhi who lived at Sabarmati (Gujarat) and Sevagram (Wardha, Maharashtra) when he was not travelling across India or in prison.
 
• **Mahatma Gandhi** founded two ashrams for community living in South Africa – Phoenix Settlement in Durban and Tolstoy Farm in Johannesburg.
